Harpreet Desai
Business Development & Sales | Remote (India)
harpreet.desai880@example.com | +91 9983189715

Seasoned sales professional focused on B2B client acquisition and account growth within technology-driven service environments. Skilled at qualifying leads, negotiating commercial terms, and driving pipeline through CRM-led processes. Comfortable working remotely to coordinate cross-functional teams and close multi-stakeholder deals.

Experience

GreenGrid — Dec 2024 - Present
Business Development Manager
Remote
- Built a prospecting cadence using Salesforce to qualify and advance 120+ leads in the first quarter, converting 18 into active opportunities and increasing pipeline value by 42%.
- Led negotiation of commercial terms with 6 mid-market clients, achieving an average deal size uplift of 28% through bundled offerings and term optimization.
- Designed and executed a targeted lead generation campaign focused on sustainability teams, generating 350 marketing-qualified leads and shortening average sales cycle from 75 to 49 days.
- Collaborated with operations and product teams to translate client requirements into scope documents, reducing contract revisions by 30% and accelerating onboarding.

Swiggy — Jun 2024 - Nov 2024
Account Executive
Remote
- Managed a book of 45+ merchant accounts, leveraging B2B Sales strategies to increase aggregate monthly GMV by 22% within four months.
- Ran targeted Lead Generation initiatives that produced 90 new merchant prospects; converted 12 into active partners with an average first-month revenue increase of 35%.
- Negotiated partnerships and commercial agreements with restaurant groups and retail partners, improving margin realization by optimizing fee structures and promotional commitments.
- Tracked activity and pipeline in Salesforce and coordinated with support teams via Jira to resolve onboarding issues, cutting time-to-live for new accounts by 18%.

SaaS Lead Nurture Workflow

Merchant Onboarding Playbook
